description: Polls an S3 prefix on a timer, downloads objects older than a minimum age, pushes each one downstream, and optionally deletes it from the bucket. Uses the aws_s3 library for signing and transport.

config.label: Interval
config.description: How often, in milliseconds, the runtime invokes the polling script. 60000 is one minute.

config.label: Region
config.description: The AWS region the bucket lives in. Must match the bucket, or S3 rejects the signature.

config.label: Access Key
config.description: AWS access key ID. Stored encrypted and decrypted only when the script reads it.

config.label: Secret Key
config.description: AWS secret access key. Stored encrypted and decrypted only when the script reads it.

config.label: Endpoint Override
config.description: Leave blank for AWS. Set to a full base URL to point at an S3-compatible service such as MinIO or LocalStack.

config.label: Prefix
config.description: Only keys under this prefix are polled. A trailing slash makes it behave like a folder.

config.label: Minimum Object Age
config.description: The minimum age, in seconds, an object must reach before it is downloaded. Stops the poller picking up an object that another process is still uploading. 60 is one minute.

config.label: Max Objects Per Poll
config.description: Upper bound on how many objects one poll handles, so a large backlog is drained over several intervals rather than in one long run.

config.label: Delete After Download
config.description: Delete each object from S3 after it has been pushed downstream. Turn off for a read-only demo that can be replayed.

config.label: Live Mode
config.description: When off, requests are signed and logged but never sent. Lets you prove configuration and signing are correct before touching a real bucket.

config.label: Verify TLS
config.description: Verify the server certificate. Leave on for AWS; turn off only for a local S3-compatible service with a self-signed certificate.
